title: Sizing a Marlowe Rewards Service Goodwill Grant
content:
This note gives the Marlowe Rewards calculation of a service goodwill grant, in whole points.

## The grant

1. **Starting figure.** The grant starts from the per-case goodwill allowance of the tier held on the posting date.
2. **Rounding.** The starting figure is rounded to the nearest whole point, a half point rounding up.
3. **Per-case limit.** The rounded figure is then limited to the per-case goodwill allowance of the tier held on the posting date.
4. **Annual limit.** After that, the figure is limited to what remains of that tier's annual goodwill allowance, once the goodwill already posted in the current calendar year is deducted.

When nothing remains of the annual allowance, no goodwill entry is posted.

## Goodwill already posted this year

This is the total of the points on the membership's service goodwill bonus entries posted from 1 January of the current calendar year up to the posting date.

## Worked examples (hypothetical allowances of 600 points per case and 1800 points per calendar year, not the figures of any tier)

| Goodwill already posted this calendar year | Remaining annual allowance | Grant |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | 1800 | 600 |
| 1500 | 300 | 300 |
| 1800 | nothing | no goodwill entry |

## Order of the limits

The per-case limit comes first and the annual limit second. In the second row, the per-case limit leaves 600 and the annual remainder then holds the grant to 300.
